City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
NOVEMBER 13, 2018
07:00
P.M.
11-13-18 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Lewis, Holloway, Argudo, Munoz and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Recognition of La Puente High School's Girls Volleyball Team
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF OCTOBER 23, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of October 23, 2018.
A-1 Minutes 10-23-18 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
PUBLIC HEARING AND CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION VACATING THE PUBLIC ALLEY EASEMENT LOCATED ON ASSESSOR PARCEL NUMBER 8472-037-007 (ALSO KNOWN AS 1103 NORTH HACIENDA BOULEVARD) WITHIN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5452, vacating the public alley easement located on Assessor Parcel Number 8472-037-007 (also known as 1103 North Hacienda Boulevard) within the City of La Puente and notice of exemption regarding same.
B-1 1103 Hacienda Alley Vacation Staff Report
B-1 1103 Hacienda Alley Vacation Attachment A Resolution
B-1 1103 Hacienda Alley Vacation Attachment B NOE
B-2
CONSIDERATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES ASSESSED BY THE CITY FOR SERVICES AND MUNICIPAL ACTIVITIES PROVIDED TO THE PUBLIC
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5441, approving a Comprehensive Schedule of Fees and Charges assessed by all City Departments for various services provided to the public
B-2 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Update Cover
B-2 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Attachment A Staff Report
B-2 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Attachment B Study
B-2 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Attachment C Fees
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1461 AND 59
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5453 approving Warrant Register No. 1461 and Resolution No. SA 18-87 approving Warrant Register No. 59.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1461
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #59
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BARR & CLARK, INC. FOR ASBESTOS AND LEAD BASED PAINT TESTING TO EXTEND THE TERM FOR A PERIOD OF ONE YEAR AND INCREASE THE PAYMENT AMOUNT BY $15,000
It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 3 with Barr & Clark, Inc. for asbestos and lead based paint testing services and authorize the Transition Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-2 Barr and Clark Amendment 3 Staff Report
D-2 Barr and Clark Amendment 3 Attachment A Amendment
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING A SOCIAL MEDIA POLICY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5454 adopting a Social Media Policy for the City La Puente.
D-3 Social Media Policy Staff Report
D-3 Social Media Policy Attachment A Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION GRANTING A FEE WAIVER FOR THE MAINTENANCE, FIELD USE, FIELD LIGHTS AND EVENT SECURITY AND ABSORBING THE COST OF THE SPECIAL EVENT INSURANCE ASSOCIATED WITH THE LA PUENTE YOUTH COALITION’S USE OF LA PUENTE PARK FOR A COMMUNITY CARNIVAL
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5455 approving a request for a fee waiver for the Youth Coalition’s Carnival.
D-4 Youth Coalition Carnival Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-4 Youth Coalition Carnival Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-4 Youth Coalition Carnival Attachment B Event Proposal
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SIEMENS INDUSTRY INC., FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL MAINTENANCE SERVICES TO CONSENT TO THE TRANSFER TO SIEMENS MOBILITY, INC.
It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 with Siemens Mobility, Inc., for traffic signal maintenance services.
D-5 Siemens Industry Amendment Staff Report
D-5 Siemens Industry Amendment Attachment A Amendment
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE CITY’S GRAFFITI ABATEMENT PROGRAM (COUNCIL MEMBER SOLIS)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss the City’s graffiti abatement program and provide direction to Staff.
E-1 Graffiti Program Staff Report
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT SERVICE LEVELS AND LA PUENTE SPECIAL ASSIGNMENT TEAM (MAYOR LEWIS)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department service levels and the La Puente Special Assignment Team and provide direction to Staff.
E-2 LASD Service Levels Staff Report
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION CASTING THE CITY’S VOTES FOR A COUNCIL MEMBER TO REPRESENT CITIES WITHOUT PRESCRIPTIVE WATER PUMPING RIGHTS ON THE BOARD OF THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5456 casting the City’s votes for Valerie Munoz to represent cities without prescriptive water pumping rights on the Board of the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority.
E-3 WQA Election Staff Report
E-3 WQA Election Attachment A Resolution
E-3 WQA Election Attachment B Letter
E-4
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING PUENTE PRIDE COMMITTEE APPOINTMENTS (MAYOR LEWIS)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss the Puente Pride Committee, any required appointments, and provide direction to Staff.
E-4 Puente Pride Appointments Staff Report
RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION
CLOSED SESSION
1.
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION, CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL ANTICIPATED LITIGATION Initiation of litigation pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) (one potential case)
2.
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION, CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL ANTICIPATED LITIGATION Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2) (two potential cases)
3.
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION, PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT, TITLE: CITY MANAGER Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957(b)(1) (Council Member Solis)
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION

Dated this this 9th day of November, 2018
